text:
maya: Heads up — prod jobs started failing after key rotation, AccessDenied on KMS Decrypt. Anyone seeing this?
sam: yep, got alerts. CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt Deny for assumed role arn:aws:sts::... :eyes:
indra: possible propagation window with grants. Are we using grants for cross-account decrypts or just key policy?
maya: we're using grants for the ingest role. Rotation ran at 2026-03-20T00:02Z and key policy was updated to include new principal.
jon: two common gotchas: 1) grants are tied to original principal ARNs, rotation can invalidate expectation; 2) STS assumed role ARN vs role ARN mismatch. Check principalId in CloudTrail.
lia: CloudTrail snippet:
```
"eventName": "Decrypt",
"errorMessage": "Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt",
"userIdentity": {"principalId": "AROA...:svc-processor"}
```
ops-bot: rotation-job/rotate-cmk completed 00:02 UTC :white_check_mark:
sam: listing grants now — `aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abcd`
indra: also check if the app assumes role with session tags or session policy that restricts kms:Decrypt. Those don't show up in key policy but affect final eval.
maya: is there a recommended short-term mitigation? We can't pause traffic.
security: rollback key policy to prior version OR create a temporary grant to the assumed role principal (use GrantToken) and then re-evaluate. Also confirm CMK key-state and key-rotation alias mapping.
jon: temp grant example:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id <key> --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/svc-processor-role/session --operations Decrypt
```
lia: adding: check CloudTrail for aws:kms action context: `aws:SourceIdentity` and `aws:PrincipalOrgID` if we use those conditions.
maya: ok sam, lia — please add grants or rollback and report back. I'll page SRE if we need emergency maintenance :rotating_light:
sam: will do, updating thread in 10
indra: FYI we'll also run policy simulator with the assumed role ARN to reproduce: `aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/... --action-names kms:Decrypt`
security: after fix, put an incident doc in postmortems with root cause and action items: handle grant lifecycle across rotations, add e2e test for decrypt after rotation :memo:
maya: thanks — ping when done.
